content.comment_body: When I attempt to upload a [product_name] diagram to my [product_name] [article_no], I receive a message requesting that I select a new interface. I'm using a USB cable and have tried changing COM ports without success. I managed to transfer diagrams a few times, but after several uploads the same interface prompt reappears. Any advice? Best regards, [user_name] - Norway

Hello, Consider reinstalling the USB converter driver. After doing this, check whether your interface settings in the System Properties match the following parameters: Baud rate: 9600 Data bits: 8 Parity: None Stop bits: 1 Flow control: None FIFO buffer: Use Receive and transfer buffer: High Regards, [user_name]
Thanks for the quick response. I've already tried these steps multiple times. Do you have any other suggestions?

Here are a few additional suggestions: - Install the driver before plugging in the cable. If you did it in reverse, uninstall the driver, reinstall, and then plug in the cable. - Check if other software is occupying the COM port. - Verify whether you are using the original USB cable or a serial cable with a USB converter. - Identify the COM port number assigned when the cable is connected. If it's unusually high, try changing it to something like COM5.

Update: A new issue has appeared. The diagram can only be transferred one time before an error shows up. Re-plugging the USB cable temporarily fixes it. This recurring problem is quite frustrating. Best regards

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering unstable USB communication when uploading diagrams to the [product_name] [article_no]. Transfers are successful just once before error messages arise, prompting the selection of a different interface. The workaround of unplugging and replugging the USB cable interrupts workflow and is causing frustration, especially with frequent uploads.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a dependable and smooth upload process that supports repeated diagram transfers via USB without needing to disconnect or adjust interface settings between uploads.
